description.value: Storm Brewing is Vancouver's longest-running craft brewery, operating since 1994 out of a working brewery on Commercial Drive that customers enter through the loading dock door. Brewer James Walton and team have produced over 400 different 'Brainstorm' brews, earning a reputation as one of Canada's most creative craft beer producers — celebrated by Lonely Planet as a 'legendary local brewery.' Cyclists on the Commercial Drive corridor can pick up growler fills, tall cans, or wax-sealed bottles; the brewery's own FAQ notes customers have collected kegs by bicycle trailer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the stormbrewing.org website, which confirms address (310 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, BC), phone (604-255-9119), and product offerings (growler fills, tall cans, wax-sealed bottles). The OSM name 'Storm Growler Fills' refers to a specific service of the business that calls itself 'Storm Brewing' — flagged as a name mismatch. No explicit evidence of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill was found in website content or OSM tags; the keg FAQ does reference customers retrieving kegs by bicycle trailer, confirming cyclist traffic but not dedicated infrastructure.
concerns: OSM name 'Storm Growler Fills' does not match the business's own trading name 'Storm Brewing'; the OSM name describes a specific service rather than the establishment itself.
